featured.challenge: A new shawarma restaurant in Rabat that needed buzz before and at its opening.
featured.done: A “Coming soon” teaser before the opening, the launch reel (the mascot, the storefront, the food and the packaging, ending on “Rabat, we are here”), and the animated logo intro.
featured.deliverable: Three vertical videos: a 13-second teaser, a 15-second launch reel and a 4-second animated logo intro, in Instagram and TikTok format.

aboutPage.label: About
aboutPage.title: The work is great. The fear is in starting.
aboutPage.story: Everyone around me knew I worked in digital and audiovisual, but I never had the courage to film myself. Many good businesses feel the same: the work is great, the fear is in starting.
aboutPage.storyMore: Sync Studio was born in Agadir for exactly that. To guide local businesses, step by step, from offline to online. With modern tools, and without jargon.

aboutPage.founderPhotoAlt: Portrait of Oussama Amentag, founder of Sync Studio
aboutPage.founderBio: Videographer and editor since 2017. Oussama has worked with brands, event productions and cultural projects across Morocco: cinematic editing, colour grading, motion design, and 2D and 3D video mapping.
highlights: Co-founder and visuals director, One Eye Production (2018–2021)
Head of editing and graphics, Soufiane Production (2022–2025)
Photo editing for international watch brands, Montrichard Group (2025)
